Meta.Author: Flemming Busman
Meta.Description: Set the Quad Cortex MIDI channel (Settings > Device > MIDI) to the channel configured in RigPilot's Device Settings. VERIFY ON HARDWARE: (1) the exact bank/setlist arithmetic of "Select Preset" (CC0/CC32 + PC) - cross-check with Neural's MIDI PC Calculator, CorOS versions have differed here; (2) the value semantics of footswitch CCs 35-42 (assumed 0-63 = bypass, 64-127 = enable).

OneShot.name: Select Preset (raw bank + PC)
OneShot.description: Loads a preset by raw bank values + program number. UNVERIFIED bank arithmetic - check against Neural's MIDI PC Calculator.

OneShot.name: Select Scene
OneShot.description: Switches to scene A-H of the current preset.

OneShot.name: Set Mode
OneShot.description: Switches the footswitch layout between Preset, Scene and Stomp mode.

OneShot.name: Ignore Duplicate PC: On
OneShot.description: Makes the device ignore repeated identical Program Changes.

OneShot.description: Makes the device process repeated identical Program Changes again.

Hold.name: Looper X Open
Hold.description: Looper X is open for the duration of the block.
